#📚 **RAG PIPELINE - PERSONAL NOTES**
=================================

> 📅 DATE: 2026-09-06
>
>
> 👤 AUTHOR: Nicky
>
>
> 🎯 PROJECT: RAG from Scratch
>
>
> 📁 DATA: Steve Jobs PDFs (3 files, 626 pages)

# 🔍 WHAT THIS DOES:
1. Loads PDFs from ./data
2. Deduplicates pages using MD5 hashing
3. Chunks documents (size=1000, overlap=200)
4. Generates embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
5. Stores in ChromaDB
6. Retrieves relevant chunks for queries

# ⭐ KEY INSIGHTS:
- Deduplication MUST happen BEFORE chunking
- ChromaDB needs clear_existing=True to avoid duplicates
- Content hashing is the best deduplication method
- Logging saves hours of debugging

# 🐛 BUGS & FIXES:
- Duplicate retrieval: Fixed by deduplication
- Slow embedding: Using mps (Apple Silicon GPU)
- ChromaDB errors: Delete vector_store folder

# 🔄 WHAT I CHANGED:
- Added deduplication to PDFProcessor
- Added logging to all classes
- Added clear_existing parameter to VectorStore
- Fixed duplicate issue in retrieval

# 💡 MY LEARNINGS:
- Classes with __init__ are better than functions
- Logging = professional programming
- Always deduplicate at the source
- Personal notes help future debugging

- Add LLM for answer generation
